title: GoOrganicAfrica 44-country agricultural research evidence structural audit
scope: Structural audit of the country research register and referenced JSON evidence files; not a scientific revalidation of every source observation or a calculator-readiness certification.

structural_checks.check: Master register fetched and parsed as JSON
Register summary totals reconcile to 54 countries (10 active profiles plus 44 research records)
No country remains marked not yet researched
All 22 unique evidence-file paths fetched and parsed as valid JSON
Grouped evidence files contain 25 unique country records (16 additional-country records and 9 West African records)
Individual evidence files contain 19 unique country records plus one Morocco follow-up duplicate
All research records consistently use one schema and identical evidence depth

quality_findings: Evidence depth is uneven. Several earlier country records primarily identify official surveys, datasets, source leads and outstanding extraction tasks rather than validated crop-level tables and complete enterprise budgets.
Some countries share grouped evidence files; the country register must continue to be used as the authoritative mapping from ISO code to evidence record.
Older individual files use different field names and layouts. A future schema-normalization pass is recommended, but should preserve original observations and provenance.
The existence of a research evidence record does not establish calculator readiness.
All 44 research-only countries remain directory-only/not active; no formulas or active calculator profiles were changed.

calculator_readiness.reason: Country evidence coverage is complete, but current farmgate prices, crop-specific area/production/yield series, regional input quotations and validated crop enterprise budgets remain incomplete for multiple countries.
calculator_readiness.next_required_work: Country-by-country source extraction, discrepancy resolution, dated farmgate price collection, regional crop budgets, schema mapping, translations and calculator tests.

successful_steps: Validate UI localization keys and translated content artifacts
latest_ci_observation.failing_step: Audit rendered pages for duplicate and mixed-language content
latest_ci_observation.failure_summary: The generated agricultural-news country pages contain incorrect html lang attributes across language variants; Arabic country pages also fail the dir=rtl requirement. The browser-smoke job was skipped.
latest_ci_observation.scope_note: This is a rendered-site localization validation failure and does not indicate JSON parse failure in the country evidence files.

release_safeguards: Do not merge or deploy without explicit user approval.
Do not activate any of the 44 research-only countries based on evidence-file presence.
Do not change existing calculator formulas or the 10 active country profiles during this evidence audit.
Treat the 10 existing active profiles as requiring a separate source-freshness and calculation audit.
